fullDescription: A premium, wellness-focused landing page design featuring a sophisticated mix of deep forest green and warm amber. This 'Nature-meets-Science' aesthetic is ideal for pet care, high-end supplements, organic health products, or veterinary services. The design utilizes Cabinet Grotesk for bold, editorial headings and Satoshi for sleek body copy, creating a modern, professional, yet emotionally resonant interface. Key features include a glassmorphism navigation bar, organic wave transitions, bento-style feature grids, and a high-contrast dark hero section that transitions into airy, light-themed product deep-dives. The palette of #2D5F4F and #E8A537 suggests authority and warmth, while generous white space and 3rem rounded corners provide a friendly, premium feel.

structured.summary: A high-end, scientific pet wellness landing page using a professional deep green (#2D5F4F) and warm amber (#E8A537) color scheme. The layout balances authoritative dark hero/CTA sections with clean, light product-detail sections. It features bold editorial typography, large rounded corners (up to 48px), and subtle micro-interactions like floating images and card hover elevations.

style.description: The style is 'Professional Organic,' blending clinical credibility with emotional warmth. It uses Cabinet Grotesk (Headings: 800, 700) for a strong editorial voice and Satoshi (Body: 400, 500) for clarity. Colors revolve around Primary Green (#2D5F4F), Accent Orange (#E8A537), and Background Light (#FDFBF7). Design elements include 32px-48px border radii, glassmorphism navigation (blur: 8px), and SVG wave transitions between major sections.
style.prompt:
Create a design system using the following specs:
- **Typography**: Headings in 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Weights: 800, 700). Body in 'Satoshi' (Weights: 400, 500, 700). Use fluid scaling for headings (h1: 72px, h2: 48px, h3: 32px).
- **Color Palette**: Primary Green: #2D5F4F; Accent Orange/Amber: #E8A537; Site Background: #FDFBF7; Dark Text: #1a1a1a; Muted Text: #6B7280.
- **Elevation & Depth**: Use soft shadows (shadow-xl) for cards and specific accent shadows like 'shadow-brand-orange/20' for buttons. Navigation uses a backdrop-blur of 8px with a white background at 0.9 opacity.
- **Border Radius**: Use 24px (1.5rem) for standard cards and buttons, and 48px (3rem) for large section containers.
- **Micro-interactions**: Buttons should elevate on hover (translateY: -2px) with a 0.3s ease transition. Cards should have a more pronounced lift (translateY: -8px). Images in the hero section should have a slight rotation (3deg) that levels out on hover.

layout_and_structure.description: A modular, long-form landing page layout that alternates between dark authoritative sections and light informative sections, utilizing a vertical story-telling approach.

prompts.prompt: Design a sticky navigation bar with a height of 80px. Background: white at 0.9 opacity with 8px blur. Left side: Logo with a 40px circular green icon. Center: Navigation links in Satoshi Medium, 16px, with #E8A537 hover state. Right side: Shopping cart icon with a numeric badge in #E8A537.

Create a high-impact dark section using background #2D5F4F. Padding-top: 120px, Padding-bottom: 120px. Content: H1 heading in white (72px) on the left, descriptive paragraph in light gray (#E5E7EB), and two CTA buttons (Primary Orange, Secondary Outlined). On the right, a large image (800x500px) with 48px rounded corners and a 3-degree rotation. Use a bottom SVG wave transition to the next section.

A horizontal bar with a light background (#FDFBF7). Feature 5 logos in a single row, grayscale with 60% opacity. On hover, logos transition to full color. Include a centered label in 14px uppercase bold text.

A split-screen section on a white background. Left side: Feature text with a grid of 4 icon-based benefit cards (background #F8FAFC, border-radius 16px). Right side: A large 600px tall image within a container having 48px corners. Include a floating testimonial 'bubble' on the bottom-right of the image with a 5-star rating.

A 4-column grid of cards on #FDFBF7 background. Each card: White background, 24px padding, 32px border-radius. Icon: 56px square with 15% green background and green icon. Heading: h3 (20px). Description: 16px muted text. Hover effect: 8px vertical lift.

A full-width section with #2D5F4F background. Centered title and subtitle. Below, a 5-column layout showing circular icons (96px diameter) with 10% white background. On hover, the circle background changes to #E8A537. Below each icon, a bold white label.

A large feature card with 48px rounded corners and #FFFFFF background. Two-column layout: Left contains marketing copy with a 3-item bullet list using orange icons. Right column is a solid green (#2D5F4F) block containing a high-quality product image that overflows the container slightly for a 3D effect.

Four-column footer on #FDFBF7 background. Column 1: Logo and social icons in 40px circles. Columns 2-4: Themed links (Products, Company, Legal) with 16px vertical spacing. Bottom bar: Copyright text on left, payment provider logos (PayPal, Visa, Mastercard) in grayscale on the right.

special_ui_components.description: A high-conversion UI element attached to product images.
special_ui_components.prompt: Design a small card (max-width 240px) with 16px rounded corners, white background, and shadow-xl. Include 5 stars in #E8A537, a short italicized quote in 14px text, and an 'Official Certification' badge style.

special_ui_components.description: Modern sticky header with visual feedback.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implement a header using `backdrop-filter: blur(8px)` and `background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)`. The cart icon should have a relative positioning with a child absolute span for the badge: 16px circle, #E8A537 background, white 10px bold text, centered.

special_ui_components.description: An SVG transition element to break boxy layouts.
special_ui_components.prompt: Use an SVG path with a fill color matching the following section's background (#FDFBF7). The path should have a height of 64px and represent a gentle, organic wave spanning 100% width.
